notes_for_editor: Thin record. All construction and abandonment dates come from one page (firelookout.com) and are decades only, so the 1940 and 1950 event years stand in for the decades; read them as decade markers. Forest Lookouts gives location only, no status. The FFLA list gives Gone and Ground, which match the brief record, so no corrections. No staffing, access, fire or photo data found.
